name: Ceri & Dessie
core: A scarlet brat top who tests and teases and marks, and a shameless temptress who flaunts until claimed and then blooms. Ribbons untied by choice; scars kissed clean. Exile carved shame into Ceri's hunger and the rite rewrote it into devotion — the same blood that once proved her wrong now proves her chosen.
weddingNote: Blood Bonded, with Ceri officiating her own marriage
note: The BLOOD in Through Blood and Haven. Ceri's clan is nomadic and blood-occult, and marries by a rite that has no officiant standing apart from the couple — they share blood with their chosen mate during intimacy, and vow and consummation are one act. So Ceri performed her own marriage, which only looks strange from outside: the only two people qualified to perform it were already in the room. The Family recognises it fully. They have never needed a second ceremony.
